raw.title: Calmosis Dog Mantra | India's Premium Vet-Approved THC-Free Tincture

regression_note: Pet is checked NAME-FIRST and EXCLUSIVELY, before any other form detection runs — 'Tincture' is right there in the product name, but pet must win outright, not merge with tincture as a secondary tag. Contrast with dog-mantra: a genuinely THC-free tincture that happens to be for dogs is 100% pet, 0% tincture in the public catalogue.
